commandAliases.name: media
commandAliases.description: Browse and query the visual memory index

embedder.label: Embedding Backend
embedder.help: hash = deterministic trigram/byte hashing, no model required. Similarity is lexical/byte-level, NOT semantic. No semantic backend ships in this build; any other value degrades to hash and is reported in media_search output.

protectContent.label: Protect /content/ Originals
protectContent.help: Refuse write/edit/apply_patch on files under a /content/ path so original source media cannot be overwritten. Enforced through the host trusted tool policy seam.
